design_note: Engineered for REAL tension: strong spark + aligned life-stage, but a faith mismatch and a meaningful gap in emotional maturity/repair capacity. There is no clean yes/no — exactly the case where a weighted sum would lie and a council must deliberate.

person_a.name: Maya
person_a.summary: Pediatric nurse, warm and high-energy, deeply practicing Catholic, wants children within a few years.

values.faith: Devout Catholic; faith is central; wants to raise children in the church.
values.family: Very family-oriented; wants 2-3 kids; close to extended family.
values.career: Loves her work but sees family as the priority over career advancement.

attraction.stated_type: Drawn to witty, grounded, physically active men.
attraction.self_described_spark_with_b: Strong — they make each other laugh, intense physical chemistry on first meetings.

emotional_profile.maturity: High — names her feelings, apologizes quickly, seeks repair after conflict.
emotional_profile.attachment_style: Secure with mild anxious tendencies under stress.
emotional_profile.growth_orientation: High — reads, journals, has done therapy, welcomes feedback.

person_a.life_stage: Ready to settle down within 1-2 years; financially stable.
dealbreakers: Someone unwilling to raise kids with faith

person_b.name: Daniel
person_b.summary: Startup product lead, sharp and funny, agnostic/secular humanist, ambivalent about kids and timeline.

values.faith: Agnostic; respects religion but does not practice; uneasy about raising kids religiously.
values.family: Open to kids 'someday' but not urgent; somewhat distant from his own family.
values.career: Career is currently the center of gravity; in an intense startup phase.

attraction.stated_type: Drawn to warm, expressive, optimistic women.
attraction.self_described_spark_with_a: Strong — finds her warmth magnetic, very physically attracted.

emotional_profile.maturity: Moderate-low — tends to withdraw/stonewall under conflict, slow to apologize.
emotional_profile.growth_orientation: Mixed — curious and self-aware in theory, but rarely acts on feedback; 'too busy right now'.

person_b.life_stage: Says he wants a relationship but timeline is fuzzy; consumed by work for the next 2-3 years.
dealbreakers: Pressure to commit on a fixed timeline
Feeling judged for not being religious
